title: UI元素显示异常或功能失效
description: UI元素存在显示异常、功能失效或错误，如界面消失、按钮无效、信息错误等，影响正常操作。
evidence: it's permanently stuck on my screen, even if i'm docked to a different place altogether
Some UI Elements seem to sometimes just flat out dissapear and not reappear until you reload the save
The "resume order" button which appears on every pending order has simply never worked for me

evidence_items.quote: The placement grid is all translucent grey, so that means there's nothing in the way...
evidence_items.description: 放置网格显示为半透明灰色，但实际有物体阻挡，指示不清晰
evidence_items.quote_zh: 放置网格全是半透明的灰色，所以这意味着没有任何东西挡路……

evidence_items.quote: the game just decides certain cells in my inventory are no longer allowed to hold anything, and then fix itself later with no explanation
evidence_items.description: 物品栏某些格子暂时无法存放物品，之后自行恢复
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏就是会突然决定我物品栏里的某些格子不再允许存放任何东西，然后又会在之后自行恢复正常，没有任何解释

evidence_items.quote: you can't even leave character creation menu
evidence_items.description: 无法离开角色创建菜单
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你甚至无法离开角色创建菜单

evidence_items.quote: Fix the scroll-wheel's zoom rubber banding after exiting a menu.
evidence_items.description: 退出菜单后滚轮缩放出现回弹
evidence_items.quote_zh: 修复退出菜单后滚轮缩放的回弹问题。

evidence_items.quote: намертво пропадает интерфейс
evidence_items.description: 界面会完全消失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 界面会彻底消失

evidence_items.quote: Летный интерфейс ломается после использования движка
evidence_items.description: 飞行界面在使用引擎后损坏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞行界面在使用引擎后就坏了

evidence_items.quote: Was unable to complete quests due to convo times disappearing.
evidence_items.description: 对话时间消失导致无法完成任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 由于对话时间消失，无法完成任务。

evidence_items.quote: оказалось что у меня была забагована панель навигации, её просто не было, из-за этого и баг в обучении, и из-за этого я не мог нормально взаимодействовать со станцией
evidence_items.description: 导航面板缺失，导致教程bug和无法正常与空间站交互
evidence_items.quote_zh: 原来我的导航面板出了bug，它根本就不存在，正因如此才导致了教程中的bug，也正因如此我无法正常与空间站互动

evidence_items.quote: UI freezes, while the rest keeps running
evidence_items.description: UI冻结而游戏继续运行
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI 冻结，而其余部分仍在运行

evidence_items.quote: Clicks often fail, like clicking on menus just do nothing
evidence_items.description: 点击菜单无反应
evidence_items.quote_zh: 点击经常失效，比如点击菜单完全没反应

evidence_items.quote: allow the player to go back to main menu from character creation
evidence_items.description: 角色创建界面无法返回主菜单
evidence_items.quote_zh: 允许玩家从角色创建界面返回主菜单

evidence_items.quote: if you click on the map during space travel, your map centers on whatever you click on, even empty space
evidence_items.description: 点击地图空白处会居中到移动的太空点，需暂停并费力拖回飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你在太空旅行时点击地图，你的地图会以你点击的任何东西为中心，哪怕是空无一物的太空

evidence_items.quote: The "resume order" button which appears on every pending order has simply never worked for me
evidence_items.description: 恢复订单按钮从未生效
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每个待处理订单上出现的“恢复订单”按钮对我来说从来就没起过作用

evidence_items.quote: There is an entire menu for a task priority system, but it's all placeholder, as it doesn't actually do anything.
evidence_items.description: 任务优先级菜单是占位符，不起作用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一个完整的任务优先级系统菜单，但它全是占位符，因为它实际上什么都不做。

evidence_items.quote: the camera rotation is dysfunctional while docking your ship. They could have fixed that, but instead they decide to let pop up annoying error messages, whenever one tries to rotate the world view.
evidence_items.description: 对接时相机旋转功能异常，弹出错误信息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在停靠你的飞船时，摄像机旋转功能失灵。他们本可以修复这个问题，却反而决定在有人试图旋转世界视角时弹出烦人的错误信息。

evidence_items.quote: It loaded to menu but then wouldn't show me a cursor or allow me to highlight the different icons
evidence_items.description: 加载到菜单后不显示光标，无法高亮图标
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它加载到了菜单，但之后不显示光标，也不让我高亮不同的图标

evidence_items.quote: Why can't I customise the UI features?
evidence_items.description: 无法自定义UI功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 为什么我不能自定义用户界面功能？

evidence_items.quote: Some UI Elements seem to sometimes just flat out dissapear and not reappear until you reload the save
evidence_items.description: 部分UI元素有时消失，需重载存档才恢复
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些UI元素似乎有时会直接消失，直到你重新加载存档才会再次出现

evidence_items.quote: my social UI bricks, and now I can no longer click on the floor to move or scroll in shops and have to restart the game
evidence_items.description: 社交 UI 卡死，无法点击移动或滚动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的社交界面就坏了，现在我再也不能点击地面来移动，也不能在商店里滚动，只能重启游戏

evidence_items.quote: find the freaking BASIC Button to bring me to the MAIN MENU?!?!
evidence_items.description: 找不到返回主菜单的基本按钮
evidence_items.quote_zh: 找到那个该死的基础按钮把我带回主菜单？！？！

evidence_items.quote: chat bubbles as physical items on floors and even for sale in some kiosk markets
evidence_items.description: 聊天气泡变成地板上的实体物品，甚至在售货亭出售
evidence_items.quote_zh: 聊天泡泡作为实体物品出现在地板上，甚至在一些售货亭市场上出售

evidence_items.quote: Animation-locking for UI elements (like navigation console) and opening inventory on items MUST go
evidence_items.description: 导航台等UI元素被2-3秒动画锁定，增加UI疲劳
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI元素（如导航控制台）的动画锁定以及打开物品上的库存功能必须取消

evidence_items.quote: Names of things are also hidden if scrolled out, so it took a while to realise ONKG (sp) was hidden under a stack of names of things.
evidence_items.description: 名称滚动出屏幕后被隐藏，难以发现ONKG
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品的名称在滚动移出后也会被隐藏，所以过了一段时间才意识到ONKG（原文如此）被藏在一堆物品名称下面。

evidence_items.quote: Unable to quit to main menu from character creation
evidence_items.description: 角色创建界面无法退出到主菜单
evidence_items.quote_zh: 无法从角色创建界面退出到主菜单

evidence_items.quote: Between every single mouse wheel scrollable drop down menu seeming to have a stuck Up button, so as soon as you scroll down it just scrolls back up again
evidence_items.description: 下拉菜单的向上按钮卡住，向下滚动会立刻弹回顶部
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每一个可用鼠标滚轮滚动的下拉菜单似乎都有一个卡住的上移按钮，所以你一向下滚动，它就会立刻滚回上面

evidence_items.quote: everytime you cancel a job task it unpauses. sometimes that can kill your game.. and its bs.
evidence_items.description: 取消任务时游戏意外取消暂停
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每次你取消一个工作任务，它就会取消暂停。有时候这会毁掉你的游戏……而且这太扯淡了。

evidence_items.quote: Except if you choose the wrong tab option like you pick the one for traits instead of skills, there's no back button.
evidence_items.description: 角色创建界面没有返回按钮，选错标签页无法返回
evidence_items.quote_zh: 除非你选错了标签页选项，比如你选了特质而不是技能的那个，那就没有返回按钮。

evidence_items.quote: For some reason there's a tooltip around your cursor that never goes away once it's there, and it doesn't really seem to be meaningful what it's there for.
evidence_items.description: 光标周围出现提示框且不会消失，含义不明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不知为何，你的光标周围有一个提示框，一旦出现就永远不会消失，而且它存在的意义似乎也不太明确。

evidence_items.quote: the UI wouldn't let me click "accept" due to the UI button not working
evidence_items.description: UI的接受按钮无法点击，导致无法请求离站许可
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI不让我点击“接受”，因为那个UI按钮不工作

evidence_items.quote: went to use nav filled nav screen with error
evidence_items.description: 导航屏幕显示错误
evidence_items.quote_zh: 去使用导航，导航屏幕充满了错误

evidence_items.quote: says you cant afford fees when you can
evidence_items.description: 经济系统显示错误，提示无法支付费用但实际可以
evidence_items.quote_zh: 明明付得起费用却说付不起

evidence_items.quote: it's permanently stuck on my screen, even if i'm docked to a different place altogether
evidence_items.description: 飞船永久卡在屏幕上，即使停靠别处也无法消除
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它就永久卡在我的屏幕上，即使我停靠在一个完全不同的地方也一样。

evidence_items.quote: UI gets buggy randomly
evidence_items.description: UI随机出现bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: UI会随机出现bug

evidence_items.quote: game had some UI bugs that i couldnt pass on
evidence_items.description: UI错误导致无法通过
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏有一些我无法忽略的UI错误

evidence_items.quote: the game menue is already failing to for example quit
evidence_items.description: 游戏菜单无法正常退出
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏菜单已经连比如退出都做不到

evidence_items.quote: a series of clunky, glitchy UI elements exploding any time you dare click on them
evidence_items.description: UI元素在点击时出现故障
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一系列笨重、故障频出的UI元素，每当你胆敢点击它们时就会爆炸

evidence_items.quote: UI issues present
evidence_items.description: 界面存在问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 存在UI问题
